name: conn_wire_board
display: Wire-to-board connectors (JST XH/PH/GH etc., board-side headers)
__comment_why__: Added 2026-07-07 for cable-harness work. Subcategory regex is ANCHORED (^Wire To Board) so the separate 'Housings (Wire To Board / Wire To Wire )' bucket — crimp housings, the cable side — can't leak in. Board-to-board/mezzanine deliberately has NO recipe: Marcus standardizes on the Hirose BM24 family. Length-ish columns (pitch) are stored as plain mm via the number parser — LCSC writes them uniformly in mm.
columns: most useful filter for harness work: --where "series ~ GH". CAUTION verified
2026-07-07: clone vendors mislabel 1.25mm families — a part tagged series=GH
had 'PicoBlade(MX 1.25)' in its description, and GH vs PicoBlade do NOT
intermate (GH latches). Treat series as a shortlist filter and confirm the
latch style in the datasheet/description before ordering.
__comment_pins__: three complementary views of the same fact, because the data
is inconsistent: numeric rows x per-row when present, plus the '1x4P'
structure string as the reliable text fallback. Value-shift noise exists in
this bucket (e.g. a mount style sitting in a rows field) — the number parser
just NULLs those out rather than storing junk.
__comment_smd__: 'Standing paste'/'Sinking paste' are LCSC's words for SMD
variants; 'Direct Insert'/'Plugin' are THT. Ternary as usual.
